intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Begin your mornings with a guided yoga session at the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud. This serene hilltop location offers breathtaking views of lush green valleys and is ideal for early risers. Since the flight arrives late on Day 1, this activity is best scheduled from Day 2 onwards. Many local studios offer portable mat rentals and guided sessions directly on the ridge, making it both accessible and affordable. The walk itself is free and the yoga session can be arranged with nearby studios like Intuitive Flow.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Seminyak Beach is one of Bali's most vibrant and well-connected beach hubs, close to a wide range of hotels, restaurants, and wellness centers. Take a beginner or intermediate surf lesson in the morning when waves are more manageable, then relax on the beach and enjoy the legendary Seminyak sunset in the evening. Surf schools like Rip Curl School of Surf are located right on the beach. This is a perfect Day 2 activity since it's near most central accommodation hubs, avoiding long travel after a late arrival.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning for surfing (08:00–11:00), Evening for sunset (17:30–19:00)

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Local Market Tour
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in Balinese food culture with a hands-on cooking class that begins with a guided tour of a traditional local market in Ubud. Learn to prepare classic dishes such as Nasi Goreng, Satay Lilit, and Lawar using fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Classes are typically held mid-morning and last about 4 hours, leaving your afternoon free for yoga or beach activities. Schools like Paon Bali Cooking Class are centrally located in Ubud, making them easy to reach from nearby hotels.

experiences.name: Tirta Empul Temple Purification Ritual
experiences.description: Visit the sacred Tirta Empul Temple, one of Bali's most spiritually significant sites, where you can participate in a traditional Hindu purification ritual in the holy spring waters. A local guide will explain the cultural and spiritual significance of each step. Dress modestly and arrive early to avoid crowds. This experience offers deep cultural immersion and is located close to Ubud, making it convenient for travelers staying in the central Ubud area. Combine it with a visit to the nearby Gunung Kawi temple complex for a full cultural day.

experiences.name: Yoga Barn Full-Day Wellness Retreat
experiences.description: Spend a full day at The Yoga Barn, one of Bali's most renowned wellness centers located in the heart of Ubud. Choose from a wide variety of classes including Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, and meditation sessions throughout the day. The center also offers healthy organic meals at its on-site café, making it easy to stay nourished between sessions. Staying in central Ubud puts you within walking distance of this hub, eliminating transport costs and time. This is an ideal mid-trip activity to recharge and align with your yoga-focused travel goals.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a pre-booked shared shuttle or Grab app ride from the airport to Ubud Boutique Stay (approx. 1.5–2 hrs, ~IDR 100,000–150,000). Check in, freshen up, and take a slow walk along Monkey Forest Road to get oriented — browse local warungs, shops, and soak in the Ubud vibe.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll to Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) to watch the free traditional Kecak or Legong dance performance if scheduled (tickets ~IDR 100,000). Wind down with dinner at a nearby warung.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the airport or grab a snack on arrival.
meals.lunch: Skip or grab a quick bite at the airport before landing.
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka near Ubud Palace — try the famous suckling pig rice plate for ~IDR 50,000–70,000.

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest and acclimatize. Download Grab app for affordable transport. Exchange some cash at a reputable money changer on Jalan Hanoman for better rates than the airport.

day_by_day.morning: Join a free or donation-based sunrise yoga class at one of Ubud's community yoga spaces (e.g., Yoga Barn community class ~IDR 120,000 or cheaper drop-ins nearby). Afterward, walk to the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (~IDR 80,000 entry) — arrive early to beat crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni Ubud) — browse handmade crafts, textiles, and souvenirs. Practice bargaining respectfully. Walk across to Ubud Palace exterior for photos (free). Grab a fresh coconut from a street vendor (~IDR 15,000).
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance at Ubud Palace or Pura Dalem Ubud (~IDR 100,000). Return to the guesthouse on foot.

meals.breakfast: Warung or guesthouse breakfast — nasi goreng or bubur ayam for ~IDR 25,000–40,000.
meals.lunch: Warung Sopa (vegetarian-friendly) on Jalan Sugriwa — full meal ~IDR 40,000–60,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Teges near the market — local rice and satay dishes ~IDR 35,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes. Bring a sarong for temple visits (or rent one at the entrance for free). Monkey Forest tip: keep bags zipped and remove glasses.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 04:30 for a guided sunrise trek to Mount Batur (active volcano). Book via a local trekking agent in Ubud the day before (~IDR 300,000–400,000 including guide and transport). Reach the summit for sunrise views over Lake Batur — breathtaking and well worth the early start.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud by midday. Rest, shower, and relax. Optional: soak tired legs at a natural hot spring near Kintamani (~IDR 50,000–75,000, ask your guide to stop on the way back).
day_by_day.evening: Gentle restorative yoga session at a local studio to recover from the trek. Quiet dinner close to the guesthouse.

meals.breakfast: Simple packed breakfast provided by the trekking guide (usually boiled eggs and banana on the summit).
meals.lunch: Warung near Kintamani on the way back — nasi campur ~IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah on Jalan Gootama — local Balinese dishes ~IDR 40,000–60,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Mount Batur trek at least one day in advance. Bring layers — the summit can be cold (12–15°C at 04:00). Wear sturdy shoes. Total cost for the day including transport, guide, and hot spring: ~IDR 400,000–500,000.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga class at The Yoga Barn (~IDR 120,000 drop-in) — one of Bali's most iconic yoga studios with multiple class styles. Afterward, visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave Temple, ~IDR 50,000) — a 9th-century archaeological site a short walk or cheap ride from Ubud.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cycle or walk the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a free, scenic 2 km ridge trail with panoramic views of rice fields and jungle. Best done in the afternoon light. Rent a bicycle in town (~IDR 50,000/day) or walk (~30 min from center).
day_by_day.evening: Browse the Ubud night market (Pasar Malam Ubud) for cheap local street food — try martabak, sate lilit, and fresh fruit juices.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or avocado toast at a budget café near the yoga studio ~IDR 35,000–50,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — nasi goreng with egg ~IDR 30,000.
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market — fill up on street food for ~IDR 40,000–60,000 total.

day_by_day.notes: Goa Gajah requires a sarong — usually provided at the entrance. The Campuhan Ridge Walk is free and stunning at golden hour. Bring water and sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Tegallalang Rice Terraces (~IDR 15,000 donation entry) — iconic UNESCO-listed terraced paddies just north of Ubud. Rent a scooter (~IDR 70,000–80,000/day) or take a cheap ojek (motorbike taxi). Walk the terraces early to avoid tour groups.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue north to Tirta Empul Temple (~IDR 50,000) — a sacred Hindu water temple where locals perform purification rituals in holy spring pools. Respectful observation is welcome. Then visit nearby Gunung Kawi temple complex (~IDR 50,000) — ancient royal tombs carved into rock faces.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Attend a free or low-cost sound healing or meditation session (check notice boards in town). Quiet evening in.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse or local warung — nasi goreng ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tegallalang — local rice plate with vegetables ~IDR 35,000–50,000.
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Rai on Jalan Monkey Forest — Balinese home cooking ~IDR 40,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Scooter rental is the most cost-effective way to explore the area. Wear a helmet (legally required). Bring a sarong for temple visits. Tirta Empul bathing requires modest dress — a sarong and sash are provided.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga and meditation at sunrise — either at your guesthouse rooftop or a riverside spot. Then visit Pura Taman Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — free to enter, beautiful lotus pond. Walk to Blanco Renaissance Museum (~IDR 80,000) for art inspiration.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a cooking class at a local family home or community kitchen (~IDR 200,000–300,000 including market visit and 4-dish meal). Learn to make tempeh satay, lawar, and black rice pudding — great value and a hands-on cultural experience.
day_by_day.evening: Relax and enjoy the meal you cooked. Light evening walk through Ubud center. Early night to rest.

meals.breakfast: Local warung — bubur ayam (rice porridge) ~IDR 20,000–30,000.
meals.lunch: Included in cooking class.
meals.dinner: Leftovers from cooking class or simple warung meal ~IDR 30,000–40,000.

day_by_day.notes: Book the cooking class the day before — look for community-run classes on notice boards in town rather than hotel-arranged ones for better prices. The market visit at dawn is a highlight.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day: check out of Ubud Boutique Stay and take a shared shuttle or Grab to Seminyak or Canggu (~IDR 100,000–150,000). Check into a budget guesthouse or hostel in Canggu (budget options: ~IDR 150,000–250,000/night for a dorm or private room). Drop bags and head to Echo Beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Echo Beach, Canggu — a laid-back surf beach with black volcanic sand. Rent a surfboard and take a beginner lesson (~IDR 150,000 for 1-hour lesson with instructor). Watch the surfers and enjoy the ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Echo Beach — one of Bali's best. Grab a Bintang beer from a beachside warung (~IDR 30,000) and watch the sun go down over the Indian Ocean.

meals.breakfast: Quick bite before checkout in Ubud ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Beachside warung at Echo Beach — grilled fish with rice ~IDR 45,000–65,000.
meals.dinner: Warung near your guesthouse in Canggu — nasi campur ~IDR 35,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: Canggu is great for budget travelers — lots of affordable warungs and guesthouses. Book accommodation in advance during peak July season. Keep valuables locked in your room.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga on the beach or at a budget yoga studio in Canggu (~IDR 80,000–120,000 drop-in). Canggu has a thriving yoga scene with affordable classes. Afterward, explore the trendy Berawa area on foot or by rented scooter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tanah Lot Temple (~IDR 60,000 entry) — one of Bali's most iconic sea temples perched on a rock formation in the ocean. It's about 20 minutes by scooter from Canggu. Explore the surrounding coastal cliffs and smaller shrines.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Tanah Lot (arrive by 17:00 for the best light). Return to Canggu for dinner. Browse the Canggu Club area or Old Man's bar for affordable drinks.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl at a budget café in Canggu ~IDR 35,000–50,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Tanah Lot — local plate ~IDR 30,000–45,000.
meals.dinner: Old Man's Canggu — burgers and local food, budget-friendly ~IDR 50,000–80,000.

day_by_day.notes: Tanah Lot is best at sunset but gets crowded — arrive early to explore. Sarong required (provided at entrance). Scooter parking at Tanah Lot costs ~IDR 5,000.

day_by_day.morning: Full beach day at Seminyak Beach — take a 15-minute scooter ride south. Walk the beach from Seminyak toward Kuta — the stretch is long, beautiful, and free. Swim in the warm Indian Ocean (average 27°C water temperature in July).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak's Jalan Laksmana (Eat Street) — window shop and browse. Visit Pura Petitenget, a coastal temple in Seminyak (free, sarong required). Relax on the beach with a coconut.
day_by_day.evening: Catch sunset at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club (entry/drink minimum ~IDR 100,000–150,000) — splurge slightly for the iconic Bali sunset experience. Return to Canggu by scooter.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast or local warung ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Warung on Seminyak Beach — grilled corn and satay sticks ~IDR 30,000–40,000.
meals.dinner: Warung in Canggu — nasi goreng with chicken ~IDR 35,000–50,000.

day_by_day.notes: July is peak season — beaches are busier but weather is ideal. Swim between the flags at Kuta/Seminyak as currents can be strong. Keep your scooter locked and valuables in a bag close to your body.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Uluwatu — take a scooter or cheap shared taxi (~IDR 100,000–150,000 return). Visit Pura Luhur Uluwatu (~IDR 50,000) — a dramatic clifftop temple 70 meters above the ocean. Arrive by 09:00 to beat tour buses.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend the cliff stairs to Padang Padang Beach (~IDR 15,000 entry) — a small, stunning cove beach featured in Eat Pray Love. Swim, snorkel, or simply relax on the white sand. Alternatively, visit Bingin Beach for a more secluded spot.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Uluwatu for the famous Kecak Fire Dance at the clifftop amphitheater at sunset (~IDR 150,000) — arguably the most dramatic setting for this performance in all of Bali. Return to Canggu.

meals.breakfast: Warung near guesthouse ~IDR 25,000.
meals.lunch: Warungs at Padang Padang Beach — fresh fish or noodles ~IDR 40,000–60,000.
meals.dinner: Warung in Canggu or Seminyak on the way back ~IDR 40,000–55,000.

day_by_day.notes: Watch your belongings at Uluwatu — monkeys will snatch glasses, phones, and hats. The Kecak Dance at sunset with ocean backdrop is unmissable. Book tickets in advance during peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Morning surf session at Batu Bolong Beach in Canggu — great beginner waves. Rent a board (~IDR 50,000/hour) or take a lesson (~IDR 150,000). The beach is a short walk from most Canggu guesthouses.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Canggu rice fields on foot or by bicycle — several paths lead through working paddy fields behind the beach area. Visit the famous Finn's Beach Club (free entry to beach area) or simply relax at a quiet stretch of Pererenan Beach.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a yoga nidra or yin yoga evening class at a Canggu studio (~IDR 100,000). Peaceful end to the day.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie and acai bowl at a budget café ~IDR 40,000–55,000.
meals.lunch: Warung near Batu Bolong — nasi campur ~IDR 35,000.
meals.dinner: Canggu local warung — mixed plate with tempeh, tofu, and vegetables ~IDR 30,000–45,000.

day_by_day.notes: July surf in Canggu is great for beginners — consistent 1–2m waves. Always surf with a buddy or within sight of a lifeguard. Stay hydrated in the heat.

day_by_day.morning: Final beach morning — return to your favorite Canggu beach for a last swim and relaxation session. Practice some beach yoga or meditation at sunrise. Pick up any last souvenirs from the Canggu market stalls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Kuta Beach for a final Indonesian beach experience — it's lively, free, and has good waves. Walk the length of the beach and browse the budget shops along Jalan Legian for last-minute gifts (batik scarves, sarongs, wooden carvings).
day_by_day.evening: Splurge slightly on a farewell dinner at a mid-range restaurant in Seminyak or enjoy a sunset cocktail by the beach. Reflect on the trip and pack for departure.

meals.breakfast: Guesthouse breakfast or smoothie bowl ~IDR 35,000–50,000.
meals.lunch: Warung on Kuta Beach — grilled seafood plate ~IDR 50,000–70,000.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner — treat yourself to a slightly nicer warung or local restaurant ~IDR 80,000–120,000.

day_by_day.notes: Start packing the night before. Confirm airport transport for the next day — book a Grab or pre-arranged shuttle. Reconfirm your flight details.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga or meditation session — even 20 minutes on your balcony or guesthouse garden. Enjoy a slow breakfast and check out. Arrange transport to Ngurah Rai International Airport (~IDR 100,000–150,000 by Grab or pre-booked shuttle). Allow 2–2.5 hours before departure for check-in and security.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure day — airport time. Browse duty-free for last Balinese snacks (Bali coffee, Krisbow crackers, chocolate). Reflect on 13 incredible days in Bali.
day_by_day.evening: Departure flight.

meals.breakfast: Final warung breakfast in Bali — nasi goreng or bubur ayam ~IDR 25,000–35,000.
meals.lunch: Light snack at the airport — airport prices are higher, so eat before arriving if possible.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport dining.

day_by_day.notes: Ngurah Rai Airport is small but can get congested in peak season — arrive early. Keep rupiah for any last-minute airport fees. Take a moment at the airport to appreciate Bali — the island of the gods deserves a proper goodbye.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport transfer to Ubud Boutique Stay (~1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along Jalan Monkey Forest to get oriented. Browse local art galleries and handicraft shops at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the vibrant Ubud Night Market (Pasar Malam Ubud) for an authentic introduction to local culture, street food, and handmade goods.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Light bite at the airport or a warung near the hotel upon arrival
meals.dinner: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka — iconic Balinese suckling pig, budget-friendly and beloved by locals (~IDR 50,000–80,000)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light to recover from the flight. Stay hydrated and avoid overplanning. Exchange currency at the airport or use a local ATM for better rates.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga class at Yoga Barn Ubud (7:00–8:30 AM) — one of Bali's most celebrated yoga studios offering Hatha or Vinyasa classes set amid rice paddies. Perfect for resetting after travel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary — walk among ancient temples and playful macaques in a lush jungle setting. Afterward, explore the Ubud Art Market for local batik, silver jewelry, and woven goods.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud temple (usually starts at 19:30). An unmissable cultural spectacle.

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan — charming garden café with Balinese pancakes, fresh fruit bowls, and strong Bali coffee
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka or Warung Teges — local warungs near Monkey Forest for nasi campur or mie goreng (~IDR 30,000–60,000)
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go — mid-range farm-to-table Indonesian cuisine with creative local flavors (~IDR 120,000–200,000 per dish)

day_by_day.notes: Book yoga class in advance via Yoga Barn website. Kecak performance tickets are ~IDR 100,000–150,000 and can be bought at the gate or through the hotel.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise trek to Tegalalang Rice Terraces (depart by 6:30 AM to catch the golden light). Walk the terraced paths, photograph the iconic UNESCO-listed landscape, and interact with local farmers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tirta Empul Temple — a sacred Hindu water temple where locals and visitors participate in purification rituals in the holy spring pools. Dress respectfully (sarong provided at entrance).
day_by_day.evening: Relax with a traditional Balinese massage at a reputable spa near the hotel, such as Karsa Spa or Taksu Spa (~IDR 150,000–250,000 for 60 min).

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the hotel or grab a banana pancake from a street stall near Tegalalang
meals.lunch: Swept Away Restaurant near Tegalalang — mid-range café with rice terrace views and Indonesian/Western menu
meals.dinner: Bridges Ubud — elegant but mid-range restaurant set over the Campuhan River gorge, known for fresh local ingredients

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable walking shoes for the rice terrace trek. Bring a light rain jacket — 30mm monthly average means brief afternoon showers are possible. Sarong required at Tirta Empul (can be rented at the gate for ~IDR 15,000).

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga or meditation session at Yoga Barn (7:00 AM). Follow up with a peaceful walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a 9km trail through rolling green hills and jungle, best done before 9 AM to beat the heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum — the eccentric former home and studio of Spanish-Balinese artist Don Antonio Blanco, filled with dramatic paintings and lush tropical gardens.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a cooking class at Paon Bali Cooking Class or Casa Luna Cooking School — learn to prepare 5–6 traditional Balinese dishes including satay, lawar, and black rice pudding.

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — specialty Balinese coffee and avocado toast in a hip, artsy setting
meals.lunch: Eat the dishes you prepare in the cooking class (typically included in the class fee ~IDR 350,000–500,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah — cozy local spot with authentic Balinese home cooking, very affordable and beloved by expats

day_by_day.notes: Book the cooking class at least a day in advance. The Campuhan Ridge Walk is free and accessible directly from central Ubud — start at Pura Gunung Lebah temple.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Mount Batur — depart at 3:30 AM for a guided sunrise trek to the active volcano's crater rim (2,000m). Reach the summit by sunrise (~6:00 AM) for breathtaking panoramic views over Lake Batur and Mount Agung.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and stop at natural hot springs near Lake Batur to soak tired muscles. Return to Ubud by early afternoon for rest.
day_by_day.evening: Gentle restorative yoga session at Yoga Barn (evening class, ~17:00–18:30) followed by a quiet dinner.

meals.breakfast: Simple breakfast provided by the trekking guide at the summit (usually eggs cooked in volcanic steam, bananas, and tea)
meals.lunch: Warung by Lake Batur — fresh grilled fish (ikan bakar) with rice and sambal, lakeside setting
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant (mid-range tasting menu option) or Naughty Nuri's Warung for legendary BBQ ribs and cocktails

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur trek requires a licensed guide (mandatory, ~IDR 300,000–450,000 per person). Book through the hotel or a reputable agency. Bring warm layers — summit temperatures can drop to 10–15°C before sunrise. This is a strenuous day; pace yourself.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Enjoy a slow breakfast at the hotel and spend time by the pool or reading. Optional: gentle 30-min morning meditation in the hotel garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Seminyak (~1.5 hrs from Ubud) for a beach afternoon. Check into a day-use beach club or simply settle on Seminyak Beach with a rented sun lounger. Enjoy the warm July weather and calm seas.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the famous Bali sunset from Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club (Seminyak) — iconic sunset spots with cocktails and ambient music. Return to Ubud by private driver.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Kafe Ubud — smoothie bowls and granola in a relaxed garden setting
meals.lunch: La Lucciola Seminyak — beachfront Italian-Indonesian fusion, mid-range with stunning ocean views
meals.dinner: Merah Putih Seminyak — stunning architecture, modern Indonesian cuisine, mid-range prices (~IDR 150,000–300,000 per dish)

day_by_day.notes: Seminyak is best reached by hiring a private driver for the day (~IDR 400,000–600,000 round trip). Confirm return timing with driver before departing. Sunset at Seminyak is typically around 18:30–19:00 in July.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Pura Besakih — Bali's largest and most sacred 'Mother Temple' set on the slopes of Mount Agung. Explore the 23-temple complex and enjoy dramatic volcanic backdrop views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Sidemen Valley on the return journey — one of Bali's most scenic rural areas with traditional weaving villages, rice paddies, and views of Mount Agung. Walk through local villages and observe traditional ikat weaving.
day_by_day.evening: Back in Ubud: visit a Legong dance performance at Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — held most evenings at 19:30, a refined and elegant Balinese classical dance tradition.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel before departing for Besakih
meals.lunch: Warung near Besakih temple — simple local fare, nasi goreng or mie goreng (~IDR 25,000–50,000)
meals.dinner: Hujan Locale — award-winning Indonesian regional cuisine in a beautifully designed space in central Ubud (~IDR 120,000–200,000 per dish)

day_by_day.notes: Besakih requires a sarong and sash (available at the entrance). Hire a local guide at the temple to navigate and understand the complex (~IDR 75,000–150,000). Beware of persistent unofficial guides — insist on an official one. Legong dance tickets ~IDR 100,000.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga flow class at Yoga Barn (7:00–8:30 AM). Afterward, visit the Ubud Traditional Market early (before 10 AM when it's liveliest) — browse fresh tropical fruits, spices, flowers, and local snacks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Penglipuran Village — one of Bali's best-preserved traditional villages with bamboo forests, uniform traditional architecture, and a strong sense of community. (~45 min from Ubud)
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks and dinner in Ubud followed by a 90-minute Balinese traditional massage at Intuitive Flow Spa or COMO Shambhala Estate (splurge option) for a luxurious wind-down.

meals.breakfast: Juice Ja Café — fresh cold-pressed juices, açaí bowls, and raw vegan options near Yoga Barn
meals.lunch: Picnic-style snacks from Ubud Market (fresh fruit, jaja Bali rice cakes, coconut) or a warung in Penglipuran Village
meals.dinner: Elephant Restaurant Ubud — romantic garden setting, Indonesian and international menu, mid-range pricing

day_by_day.notes: Penglipuran Village entrance fee is ~IDR 30,000. The bamboo forest walk within the village is free and beautiful. Arrive early to avoid tour groups.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Nusa Penida — take an early morning fast boat from Sanur Beach (~45 min, depart 7:00–8:00 AM). Visit the iconic Kelingking Beach (T-Rex cliff viewpoint), one of Bali's most photographed landscapes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Crystal Bay — one of Nusa Penida's most beautiful beaches with clear turquoise water, white sand, and excellent snorkeling. Swim and snorkel with tropical fish and possibly manta rays.
day_by_day.evening: Return fast boat to Sanur (~17:00). Transfer back to Ubud. Relaxed evening at the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel or grab food at Sanur harbor before boarding
meals.lunch: Warung at Crystal Bay beach — fresh grilled fish, coconut water, and rice (~IDR 50,000–80,000)
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa Ubud — popular vegetarian/vegan restaurant with generous portions and a peaceful garden

day_by_day.notes: Book fast boat in advance (~IDR 150,000–200,000 each way). Hire a local scooter driver on Nusa Penida for the day (~IDR 150,000–200,000) as roads are rough. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, snorkel gear (can be rented), and plenty of water. Kelingking descent is steep — optional but rewarding.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise visit to Pura Ulun Danu Bratan — a stunning water temple set on Lake Bratan in Bedugul highlands. The misty mountain air and floating temple create a magical atmosphere, best before 8 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Bali Botanical Gardens (Kebun Raya Bali) nearby — 157 hectares of tropical plants, orchid gardens, and peaceful walking paths. Visit the nearby Jatiluwih Rice Terraces (UNESCO World Heritage Site) — more expansive and less touristy than Tegalalang.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Attend an evening sound healing or Yin yoga class at Yoga Barn for deep relaxation.

meals.breakfast: Light hotel breakfast before early departure
meals.lunch: Warung Makan Sederhana near Jatiluwih — authentic local warung with views of the rice terraces
meals.dinner: Alaya Resort Restaurant Ubud — elegant open-air dining with Balinese cuisine and a lovely garden atmosphere

day_by_day.notes: Bedugul is ~1.5 hrs from Ubud. Hire a private driver for the day (~IDR 500,000–700,000). Bring a light jacket as highland temperatures can be cooler (20–22°C). Jatiluwih has a small entrance fee (~IDR 20,000 per person).

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga session at Yoga Barn — choose a longer 90-minute class such as Kundalini or Yin Yang. Reflect on the trip and set intentions for the day ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transfer to Canggu (~1 hr from Ubud) for a beach and surf culture afternoon. Rent a surfboard or take a beginner surf lesson at Batu Bolong Beach (great for all levels). Canggu has a laid-back, bohemian vibe perfect for a relaxed afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Canggu's vibrant café and bar scene. Visit La Brisa beach club for sunset cocktails — a stunning driftwood-decorated venue on Echo Beach. Stay for dinner or head to Old Man's Bar for a lively, social atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Kafe Ubud or hotel breakfast — fuel up before yoga
meals.lunch: Betelnut Café Canggu — healthy bowls, smoothies, and sandwiches in a relaxed garden setting
meals.dinner: Crate Café or Deus Ex Machina Canggu — trendy mid-range spots with international food, craft beer, and live music

day_by_day.notes: Surf lessons at Batu Bolong are ~IDR 150,000–250,000 per hour including board and instructor. Book through beach vendors or in advance online. Return to Ubud by private driver in the evening (~IDR 300,000–400,000).

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely final morning in Ubud. Visit the Agung Rai Museum of Art (ARMA) — a beautifully landscaped museum showcasing traditional and modern Balinese and Indonesian art. Attend a free morning cultural performance often held on the grounds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at the Ubud Art Market and along Jalan Raya Ubud. Look for hand-carved wooden items, silver jewelry, Balinese paintings, and organic beauty products. Pack and prepare for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at one of Ubud's finest mid-range restaurants. Enjoy a final Balinese sunset from the Campuhan Ridge or a rooftop café.

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — one last specialty Bali coffee and a hearty breakfast
meals.lunch: Naughty Nuri's Warung — iconic BBQ ribs and martinis, a beloved Ubud institution
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — splurge-worthy farewell dinner with French-Indonesian tasting menus in a romantic garden (~IDR 500,000–900,000 per person for full experience)

day_by_day.notes: ARMA entrance is ~IDR 80,000 and includes a cultural performance. Confirm checkout time with the hotel and arrange airport transfer for the following day. Tip your hotel staff and drivers — tipping is appreciated in Bali.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk or gentle yoga stretch in the hotel garden. Enjoy a last Balinese breakfast at leisure — fresh fruit, jamu (traditional herbal drink), and local coffee.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Ubud Boutique Stay. Transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport (~1.5–2 hrs, allow extra time). Browse duty-free for last-minute Bali coffee, chocolate, or local spirits.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali. Carry warm memories of rice terraces, sacred temples, yoga sunrises, and turquoise beaches.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — enjoy fully before checkout
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge — Bali's international terminal has decent mid-range dining options
meals.dinner: On the flight

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for the drive to the airport plus check-in and security. Pre-book your airport transfer through the hotel to avoid last-minute stress. Bali's airport can be busy — arrive early. Selamat jalan — safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Ubud Boutique Stay in Ubud (approx. 1.5 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink and orientation tour of the property. Take a leisurely stroll through the nearby Ubud Monkey Forest Sacred Nature Reserve to ease into Bali time.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the hotel's terrace or rooftop lounge overlooking the jungle canopy. Light orientation walk through Ubud's central art market streets.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight or airport dining
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Dinner at Locavore, Ubud's celebrated farm-to-table fine dining restaurant. Reserve the tasting menu featuring hyper-local Indonesian ingredients with sommelier-paired wines.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance through the hotel. Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Confirm Locavore reservation well ahead — it books out weeks in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session at the hotel's open-air pavilion or a premium yoga class at Radiantly Alive Yoga Studio in central Ubud — one of Bali's most respected studios offering Hatha, Vinyasa, and Yin classes with world-class instructors.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided tour of the UNESCO-listed Tegalalang Rice Terraces. Walk the emerald green terraced fields, learn about the traditional Subak irrigation system, and enjoy panoramic photography opportunities. Visit a local artisan workshop for silver jewelry or woodcarving.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak fire dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud temple — an iconic cultural spectacle set against a jungle backdrop.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet breakfast at the hotel — fresh tropical fruit, Balinese black rice porridge, eggs benedict, and cold-pressed juices.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud — elegant riverside dining with refined Indonesian and international cuisine.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — award-winning French-Indonesian fusion with a 7-course degustation menu in a romantic garden setting.

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak performance tickets in advance. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the rice terrace trek. Bring a light layer for the evening performance.

day_by_day.morning: Private 90-minute sunrise yoga and pranayama session at Yoga Barn, Ubud's premier wellness sanctuary. Follow with a 60-minute traditional Balinese massage at the hotel spa to restore the body.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung) and the surrounding galleries of the Ubud Art Market. Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum — a flamboyant artist's villa perched above the Campuhan River with stunning paintings and architecture.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a scenic hilltop trail above the confluence of two sacred rivers, offering golden-hour views over rice paddies and jungle valleys.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast with a Balinese ceremonial coffee (Kopi Luwak tasting option available).
meals.lunch: Lunch at Bridges Bali — sophisticated international cuisine served on a stunning multi-tiered terrace above the Campuhan River gorge.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Room4Dessert — avant-garde dessert-focused dining experience by world-renowned chef Will Goldfarb, with a unique tasting journey.

day_by_day.notes: Campuhan Ridge Walk is best done at golden hour (around 17:30–18:30 in July). Wear light breathable clothing. The trail is about 3 km round trip and is paved.

day_by_day.morning: Private early morning visit to the sacred Tirta Empul Temple — one of Bali's holiest sites. Witness or participate (with appropriate sarong attire) in the purification water ritual in the holy spring pools. Guided by a local Balinese cultural expert.
day_by_day.afternoon: Drive to Kintamani for panoramic views of Mount Batur volcano and the caldera lake. Visit Batur Geopark Museum and enjoy the dramatic highland landscape. Optional: stop at a Balinese coffee and spice plantation for a guided tasting tour.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Unwind with a 2-hour couples' or solo spa ritual at the hotel — volcanic stone massage and floral bath soak.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the hotel before early temple departure.
meals.lunch: Lunch with a view at Lakeview Eco Lodge Restaurant in Kintamani — set on the crater rim with sweeping volcano vistas and a Balinese buffet.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Hujan Locale — a celebrated restaurant spotlighting regional Indonesian cuisine from across the archipelago in a chic colonial-era setting.

day_by_day.notes: Sarongs are mandatory at Tirta Empul and are available to borrow at the temple entrance. Arrive by 07:00 to avoid crowds. The Kintamani drive is approximately 45 minutes from Ubud.

day_by_day.morning: Full-morning immersive yoga and meditation retreat experience at The Yoga Barn — choose from a 2-hour Kundalini or Restorative Yoga workshop. Follow with a sound healing bowl session for deep relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Balinese cooking class at a premium culinary school in Ubud — visit a local market to select ingredients, then prepare 4–5 traditional dishes including lawar, sate lilit, and black rice pudding under expert chef guidance.
day_by_day.evening: Leisure evening in Ubud — explore the boutique shops along Jalan Dewi Sita for curated Balinese textiles, ceramics, and artworks. Enjoy a nightcap at a rooftop bar.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — avocado toast on sourdough, smoothie bowls, and Balinese herbal jamu wellness shots.
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes prepared during the cooking class as part of the culinary experience.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Alaya Resort's Plantation Restaurant — romantic garden dining with contemporary Balinese cuisine and live acoustic music.

day_by_day.notes: The cooking class typically runs 10:00–13:00. Book with Paon Bali or Casa Luna Cooking School for a premium experience. Carry cash for market shopping.

day_by_day.morning: Private transfer to Seminyak/Canggu coastal area (approx. 1.5 hrs). Morning beach yoga session on the sands of Batu Bolong Beach or Echo Beach with a certified private instructor — sun salutations with the Indian Ocean as your backdrop.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at leisure on Seminyak Beach. Rent a premium sun lounger at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club — enjoy the beach, pool, and signature cocktails. Optional: surfing lesson for beginners on Batu Bolong's gentle waves.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Potato Head Beach Club — one of Bali's most iconic sunset venues with a stunning amphitheater-style pool overlooking the sea.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel before departure.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Sisterfields, Seminyak — acclaimed brunch and lunch spot with exceptional coffee, grain bowls, and creative sandwiches.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Merah Putih, Seminyak — Bali's most architecturally stunning restaurant, housed under a dramatic vaulted bamboo ceiling, serving refined Indonesian cuisine.

day_by_day.notes: This is a day trip to the coast — return to Ubud in the evening or consider a night in a coastal hotel if preferred. Arrange private driver for the full day. July weather at the coast is ideal — low humidity and sunny.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise trek up Mount Batur volcano (1,717m). Depart Ubud at 03:30 with a certified guide. Reach the summit by sunrise (approx. 05:30–06:00) for breathtaking panoramic views over the caldera, Lake Batur, and Mount Agung. Cook eggs in the volcanic steam vents at the summit.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the base by 09:00–10:00. Reward yourself with a relaxing soak at Toya Devasya Natural Hot Springs at the foot of Mount Batur — mineral-rich volcanic pools overlooking the caldera lake. Return to Ubud by early afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Complete rest and recovery evening. Indulge in a full in-room spa treatment — aromatherapy massage and rejuvenating facial.

meals.breakfast: Light packed breakfast provided by the trekking guide at the summit (sandwiches, bananas, hot tea/coffee).
meals.lunch: Late brunch at Warwick Ibah Luxury Villas & Spa restaurant — tranquil riverside setting with a refined Indonesian and Western menu.
meals.dinner: In-hotel dining or private in-room dinner experience curated by the hotel chef — a romantic candlelit setup with a bespoke Balinese tasting menu.

day_by_day.notes: The Batur trek requires an early 03:00–03:30 departure from Ubud. Book a licensed guide through the hotel concierge. Wear layers — summit temperatures can drop to 10°C before sunrise. Bring a headlamp and sturdy shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Gentle restorative yoga class at Radiantly Alive to recover from the Batur trek. Follow with a 90-minute deep tissue or hot stone massage at the hotel spa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Cultural afternoon: visit the Agung Rai Museum of Art (ARMA) — Ubud's finest art museum set in lush gardens, showcasing traditional and contemporary Balinese and Indonesian art. Enjoy a guided tour with an art historian.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a premium private Legong dance performance arranged through the hotel — an intimate cultural showcase of Bali's most refined classical dance form.

meals.breakfast: Full hotel breakfast — eggs cooked to order, tropical fruit platter, and freshly baked pastries.
meals.lunch: Lunch at ARMA Resort Restaurant — a beautiful open-air pavilion within the museum complex serving Indonesian and international dishes.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Naughty Nuri's Warung — an Ubud institution famous for its legendary pork ribs and martinis. A premium casual dining experience beloved by locals and visitors alike.

day_by_day.notes: ARMA also offers Balinese painting and batik workshops if interested — can be arranged for the afternoon. The private Legong performance can be organized through the hotel concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Private full-day excursion to East Bali. Begin with a visit to Pura Besakih — the 'Mother Temple' of Bali, dramatically set on the slopes of Mount Agung. Guided tour with a local Balinese priest explaining the temple's spiritual significance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to Candidasa coastal area on Bali's serene east coast. Explore the traditional Tenganan Pegringsingan village — one of Bali's last original Bali Aga (pre-Hindu) villages, famous for the rare double ikat geringsing weaving tradition.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Virgin Beach (Pasir Putih) — a secluded white sand beach accessible by a short walk through coconut groves. Pristine, uncrowded, and utterly beautiful.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast before departure.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Lotus Seaview Restaurant in Candidasa — fresh seafood and Indonesian cuisine with stunning ocean views.
meals.dinner: Return to Ubud. Dinner at Bambu Restaurant — a refined open-air dining experience in a bamboo-surrounded garden, specializing in traditional Balinese cuisine.

day_by_day.notes: Full-day trip — approximately 8–9 hours including travel. Hire a private driver and guide for the day. Besakih requires a donation and official temple guide. Bring a sarong for temple visits.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Yin Yoga and breathwork session at The Yoga Barn. Follow with a Balinese Boreh herbal body scrub treatment at the spa — a traditional warming spice paste used by Balinese farmers to soothe muscles.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private silver jewelry-making workshop in Celuk village — Bali's renowned silver crafting center. Create your own custom piece under the guidance of a master silversmith to take home as a unique keepsake.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset river walk along the Wos River valley below Ubud. Enjoy the fireflies emerging at dusk along the jungle riverbanks — a magical and rare natural spectacle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast with a focus on the wellness menu — acai bowls, green smoothies, chia pudding, and herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Kafe Ubud — a beloved health-conscious café with organic salads, cold-pressed juices, and plant-based bowls in a relaxed garden setting.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Cascades Restaurant at Viceroy Bali — one of Ubud's most luxurious dining venues, perched above a dramatic valley with an infinity pool backdrop and a refined contemporary menu.

day_by_day.notes: The silver workshop in Celuk is approximately 20 minutes from Ubud. Allow 2–3 hours for the workshop. Book in advance through the hotel concierge. The firefly walk is best experienced after 19:00.

day_by_day.morning: Private transfer to Nusa Penida island (1.5 hrs drive to Sanur + 45-min fast boat). Morning visit to Kelingking Beach — the iconic T-Rex cliff viewpoint with a dramatic turquoise bay below. Optional hike down to the beach for the most dedicated adventurers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Broken Beach (Pasih Uug) and Angel's Billabong — a stunning natural infinity rock pool at the island's edge. Snorkeling at Crystal Bay with vibrant coral reefs and the chance to spot Mola Mola (ocean sunfish) in season.
day_by_day.evening: Return boat to Sanur and private transfer back to Ubud. Relaxing evening at the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Early hotel breakfast before departure.
meals.lunch: Lunch at a beachside warung on Nusa Penida — fresh grilled fish, coconut rice, and cold Bintang beer with an ocean view.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Ibu Oka — Ubud's legendary suckling pig (babi guling) restaurant, a Bali institution. A must-try cultural dining experience.

day_by_day.notes: Nusa Penida is a full-day excursion. Book a private speedboat and local guide for comfort and efficiency. Roads on Nusa Penida are rugged — a 4WD vehicle is recommended. Bring reef-safe sunscreen and snorkeling gear (or rent on the island).

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise yoga session at the hotel's open-air pavilion — a mindful, reflective practice to honor the journey. Follow with a luxurious 2-hour couples' spa ritual: Javanese lulur scrub, flower bath, and full-body massage.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisure afternoon for last-minute shopping and exploration in Ubud. Visit JJ Bali Button for premium textile souvenirs, or browse the curated boutiques along Jalan Hanoman. Stop at a local healer (Balian) for a traditional blessing ceremony — a deeply meaningful Balinese spiritual experience.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the finest table in Ubud — a private chef's table experience at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique, or a special in-hotel candlelit dinner arranged by the property's culinary team under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent final hotel breakfast — order everything you've loved throughout the stay.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Sari Organik — a charming farm-to-table restaurant nestled in the rice fields of Ubud, accessible via a scenic walk through paddies.
meals.dinner: Premium farewell dinner at Mozaic Restaurant Gastronomique — the full 9-course Chef's Surprise tasting menu with wine pairings. A truly unforgettable final evening.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm farewell dinner reservation well in advance. Consider purchasing Balinese vanilla, coffee, or artisan crafts as premium gifts. Pack bags this evening for an early departure if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning gentle yoga or meditation in the hotel garden. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast. Check out and arrange private transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport (allow 2–2.5 hours for the journey depending on traffic).
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport transfer and departure formalities. Enjoy the airport's premium lounge facilities before boarding.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Bali — carry the warmth, tranquility, and spirit of the Island of the Gods home with you.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — savor every last bite of tropical fruit, Balinese coffee, and fresh pastries.
meals.lunch: Light meal at the airport's premium lounge or a final bite at a Ngurah Rai restaurant before departure.
meals.dinner: In-flight dining

day_by_day.notes: Allow ample time for the Ubud-to-airport transfer — traffic can be unpredictable, especially on weekends. Aim to depart the hotel at least 3 hours before your flight. Confirm transfer with the hotel concierge the night before. Selamat jalan — safe travels!
